blindSummary: Male same-sex conduct is criminalised here (14 years, unenforced) and there is no legal gender recognition. Society is tiny, remote and church-dominated, with no visible LGBT community or support infrastructure - formal legal exposure is high even though the law is not actively applied.
blindOutOfScope: Criminalisation is unenforced; the evidence base is very thin.
blindTangential: Male same-sex conduct criminalised (14 years, unenforced) — formal exposure for visitors travelling with partners.
